issue_context.title: iperf3: Provide Long-term Statistics
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Currently the senors provided by the iperf3 integration aren't marked so that HA can use them for long-term statistics.
Please add `state_class` according to the [guidelines](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/sensor/#long-term-statistics) to enable iperf3 sensors to be used for long-term statistics.
This will allow to use graphs in the UI showing long-term fluctuations of the bandwidth measured by the iperf3 integration.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.12.9
